tagline.pt: Alojamento Git — fork do Gitea governado pela comunidade
tagline.ja: Git ホスティング — コミュニティ運営の Gitea フォーク

tagline.hi: Git होस्टिंग — कम्युनिटी द्वारा संचालित Gitea फ़ोर्क

notes: Offered alongside Gitea because existing sites are not interchangeable and community governance is part of the choice.
Like Gitea, persists SQLite in /data and does not publish SSH; the server owns host port 22.
ROOT_URL keeps clone commands, webhooks and emails pointed at the site domain.
